# Zillow.com 爬虫

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/zillow-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/zillow-scraper.md)

示例爬虫，用于收集来自 Zillow.com 的房产数据，使用 Python 和 [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) 网页抓取 API 编写。属于 [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.zh-CN.md) 项目。

- **指南:** [How to Scrape Zillow Real Estate Property Data in Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-zillow)
- **代码:** [`zillow.py`](zillow.py) · **示例运行:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **测试:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **示例输出:** [Property pages](results/property.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## 抓取内容

- Zillow 搜索，查找房产列表
- Zillow 房产页面，获取房产数据集

## 函数

- `scrape_search(url, max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[dict]`: base search function which is used by sale and rent search functions
- `scrape_properties(urls)`: scrape zillow property pages for property data

这些函数是 `async` 函数：请使用 `asyncio.run(...)` 运行，或使用 `await` 调用。

## 输出

这些函数返回普通的字典和列表。示例输出的字段（第一项的顶层键）：

- [`results/property.json`](results/property.json): `zpid`, `palsId`, `stateId`, `countyId`, `cityId`, `country`, `isNonOwnerOccupied`, `propertyHasLasViolation`, `photoCount`, `hdpTypeDimension`, `listingTypeDimension`, `rentalMarketingTreatments`, `contactAgentFormVariant`, `taxAssessedValue`, `description`, `topNavJson`, `city`, `state`, `streetAddress`, `zipcode`, `homeStatus`, `homeType`, `isListingClaimedByCurrentSignedInUser`, `isCurrentSignedInAgentResponsible`, `isCurrentSignedInUserVerifiedOwner`, `moveHomeMapLocationLink`, `propertyUpdatePageLink`, `editPropertyHistorylink`, `propertyEventLogLink`, `isVerifiedClaimedByCurrentSignedInUser`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `livingAreaValue`, `livingAreaUnitsShort`, `address`, `attributionInfo`, `listing_sub_type`, `responsivePhotos`, `isPremierBuilder`, `price`, … (85 更多)
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `zpid`, `palsId`, `id`, `rawHomeStatusCd`, `marketingStatusSimplifiedCd`, `imgSrc`, `hasImage`, `detailUrl`, `statusType`, `statusText`, `countryCurrency`, `price`, `unformattedPrice`, `address`, `addressStreet`, `addressCity`, `addressState`, `addressZipcode`, `isUndisclosedAddress`, `shouldShowRequestOnPrice`, `beds`, `baths`, `area`, `latLong`, `isZillowOwned`, `flexFieldText`, `contentType`, `hdpData`, `isUserClaimingOwner`, `isUserConfirmedClaim`, `pgapt`, `sgapt`, `zestimate`, `shouldShowZestimateAsPrice`, `has3DModel`, `hasVideo`, `isHomeRec`, `hasAdditionalAttributions`, `isFeaturedListing`, `isShowcaseListing`, … (6 更多)

## Scrapfly 设置

[`zillow.py`](zillow.py) 中的 `BASE_CONFIG` 保存请求的默认设置，参见 [Scrape API 文档](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started)：

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly 的 [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)，即其反机器人绕过功能
- `country` = `"US"`: 代理所在国家

## 快速开始

需要 Python 3.10 及以上版本和 [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation)。

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/zillow-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # 获取地址： https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # 示例抓取，结果保存在 ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # 运行该爬虫的测试
```

测试：`test_search_scraping`, `test_property_scraping`；使用 `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>` 运行单个测试。 `run.py` 和测试会抓取真实网站，因此会消耗 Scrapfly 积分。
